title: [Shortcut Guide] Tab order enters unnamed panes and cannot reach shortcut rows
author: CarlosGtrz
summary: The accessibility report is now covered by an upstream PR that implements the same focus-order fix and targeted validation the earlier dashboard design called for.

judgment.rationale: The issue has a current linked PR that closes #50031 and changes the exact Shortcut Guide XAML files implicated by the focus-order analysis.
evidence: Issue #50031 gives a complete keyboard-only tab-order repro and names the two unnamed Pane stops plus unreachable shortcut rows.
Open PR #50479 closes #50031 and updates MainPaneControl.xaml, ShortcutsPage.xaml, and ShortcutItemView.xaml.
The PR description says it marks ContentFrame and the page ScrollViewer as non-tab-stop hosts and makes ShortcutItemView the focusable row with UIA name and context-flyout ownership.
The PR includes automated UI-regression evidence showing Tab now enters the shortcut list on the patched build.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR #50479 as the live fix vehicle and avoid reopening a duplicate design queue item for this report.

fix_assessment.rationale: A current upstream PR closes the issue and implements the same XAML focus corrections already identified by prior triage.

issue_context.summary: Shortcut Guide’s full overlay trapped keyboard users on unnamed structural panes instead of the shortcut rows, but that focus bug now has an active upstream fix PR.
known_information: The report enumerates the exact Tab sequence and confirms Up/Down navigation in the app rail still works.
No additional issue comments were added after filing.
PR #50479 closes #50031 and updates the three XAML files named in the prior design.
The PR body includes before/after UI automation evidence and automated regression runs.
inferences: The linked PR is implementing the same structural-host and focusable-row changes already justified by earlier dashboard analysis.
Maintainers no longer need a separate design artifact to start work; they need the PR review loop to complete.
issue_context.analysis: This should move out of design-queue treatment and into handled-by-linked-fix status. The dashboard artifact’s job is to point to the open PR, not to expose an obsolete pre-PR design action.
initial_investigation: PR #50479 specifically changes src/modules/ShortcutGuide/ShortcutGuide.Ui/ShortcutGuideXAML/Controls/MainPaneControl.xaml, Pages/ShortcutsPage.xaml, and Controls/ShortcutItemView.xaml.
The PR description explicitly names ContentFrame and ScrollViewer as the unnamed intermediate focus stops and moves the row context flyout onto the focusable UserControl.
Current source still matches the pre-fix state in main, which explains why the issue remains open until the PR lands.
